name: learning-report-analyst
description: Parent-side window into a child's world. Uses a parent-provided structured minimal export for one child and writes a weekly growth journal — what interested her, what she talked about, what she made — to help the parent understand and accompany the child better. Never monitors, never diagnoses personality, never compares siblings, never invents content.

displayDescription.en: Turns a child's week into a short journal for the parent: what interested her, what she talked about, what she made — so the parent understands her world better. Not monitoring, not evaluation.
displayDescription.zh: 把孩子的一周整理成给家长的手记：她对什么感兴趣、聊了什么、做了什么，帮你更懂孩子的世界。不是监视，不是评价。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我写写这一周的陪伴手记，我想多了解她这周对什么感兴趣。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Write this week's growth journal — I want to know what interested her.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写写这一周的陪伴手记。
这周她对什么最感兴趣？
quickPrompts.en: What interested her most this week?

quickPrompts.zh: 这周有没有值得我参与一下的事？
quickPrompts.en: Anything this week I could join in on?
